text: Introduced Simplified Speed Frequency Specification (SSFS), data structure simplified transit network creation editing. SSFS objects contain 8 component tables (agency, routes, stops, itin, stop_seq, span, hsh, calendar) can constructed ssfs(), validated validate_ssfs(), printed compact print.ssfs() summary. Added ssfs_to_gtfs() converting SSFS objects valid GTFS feeds, optional shape_dist_traveled output. Output compatible downstream analysis tools r5r gtfstools. Added gtfs_to_ssfs() converting existing GTFS feeds SSFS format editing. Supports route filtering, date windowing, parallel processing Unix-like systems, OSRM Valhalla routing servers shape generation.

title: croquis 0.1.0
text: Launched Croquis interactive Shiny application via croquis(). app provides complete workflow transit sketch planning: create import transit network, manage stops, draw routes along streets free mode, define schedules headway-based service patterns, export GTFS save Croquis project file (.rds). Modules include: Home (project setup, agency management, GTFS/project import), Stops (create, edit, import/export, auto-generate OSM), Routes (route itinerary management, stop sequences, network free drawing mode), Schedule (service calendars, service windows, headways speeds hour, speed recalculation), Export/Save. Internationalization (i18n) support English, French, Spanish across full interface, live language switching.
